Practice-feature PCA (256 Train images, passes 2-5): principal direction PC1 of the 1024-d pooled CLIP feature has variance 27.4 and the head's fake-minus-real direction has component +0.103 on it, so it adds 0.54 std to the logit margin, but the real/fake separation along PC1 is d'=-0.076 (within noise). It is a label-blind nuisance the FF++ head reads. Remove that one direction from the head's difference vector (W0 += c/2 v1, W1 -= c/2 v1, c=wd.v1; W0+W1 unchanged) and move the bias by c*(v1.mu) so the practice-mean margin is unchanged (no threshold move).

Ablation (practice passes 6-9) showed the 96 FF++-learned rank-1 attention residuals carry most of the fake signal: practice AUC 0.686 with them off vs 0.797 on, d' 0.79 vs 1.27, while their |S| is only ~1e-3..2.5e-2. Hypothesis: training under weight decay 5e-4 left these 96 scalars under-strength, so turning the forgery-cue 'volume' up by a fixed 1.5x (chosen a priori, not searched) increases separation. Pre-registered rule: keep only if practice AUC on the passes-2-5 images beats the edit-1 model on the same images; otherwise revert with no validation check.
